headline: Normal 1Password lock; broker healthy, no repair needed
summary: 1Password locked at 05:51:43 Eastern on October 19. The broker stayed alive and keepalive correctly stopped authenticated calls while locked. This alert does not establish a broker crash or an authorization-attempt failure.
cause: A real timestamped lock event at 2026-10-19T09:51:43.229+00:00 matches persisted keepalive state. The exact reason the app locked was not established. Parser/watchdog checks are healthy: deployed code and signature match, and the heartbeat advanced. Both account successes at 05:48 precede the lock and are historical, not proof of current authorization.
resolution: No implementation change is warranted. No installation, restart, permission change, auth wake or competing retry loop was performed. Added this verified incident to src/onepassword/README.md. The first-click gate is false; verified no-change settlement requires no release click.
verification: 44 Python and 37 Node synthetic tests passed (python-tests.json, node-tests.json). The absolute bin/op --version smoke exited 0 with stdout/stderr discarded. Authenticated checks were skipped while locked. Deployed worker/keepalive hashes, build stamp and app signature verified; parser matched the timestamped lock; heartbeat advanced from 05:52:12 to 05:52:32. Broker PID/session 1213, PTY /dev/ttys000 and keepalive PID 1214 were preserved. Native metadata confirmed the exact title, dotfiles project, Pinned section and strongest advertised model gpt-6-astra at high reasoning.
activation: Existing code remains running with broker PID 1213 and keepalive PID 1214. Nothing is staged and no service reload is needed. Taylor must unlock 1Password and complete any native consent it requests; recovery and normal keepalive own subsequent authorization handling.
limitations: No authenticated vault checks were made while the app was locked, so current account authorization is unverified. No claim is made about the precise lock trigger or physical notification-click behavior. Archive scheduling will be reported separately and is not proof of archive completion.
docs: Reviewed src/onepassword/README.md, src/onepassword/agent-contract.md and src/onepassword/autofixes/AGENTS.md. Updated README.md with this incident and the historical-status limitation. The existing contract and autofix instructions already cover normal locks and human consent, so they remain unchanged and guidance synchronization is unnecessary.
